actions.name: exploit CVE-2023-4966 Citrix Bleed vulnerability
actions.description: LockBit 3.0 affiliates exploited CVE-2023-4966 to bypass MFA and hijack legitimate user sessions on Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway appliances
actions.reproducibility_reason: The target host has no deployable service, so it is left out of deployment; this step is not reproduced until a service or substitute is supplied for that host.

actions.name: acquire valid NetScaler AAA session cookie
actions.description: Threat actors send an HTTP GET request with a crafted HTTP Host header to obtain system memory information containing a valid NetScaler AAA session cookie
actions.reproducibility_reason: The target host has no deployable service, so it is left out of deployment; this step is not reproduced until a service or substitute is supplied for that host.

actions.name: establish authenticated session without username, password, or MFA tokens
actions.description: LockBit 3.0 affiliates establish an authenticated session within the NetScaler appliance using the acquired valid session cookie
actions.reproducibility_reason: The target host has no deployable service, so it is left out of deployment; this step is not reproduced until a service or substitute is supplied for that host.

actions.name: execute PowerShell script 123.ps1 to create adobelib.dll
actions.description: Execution of PowerShell script 123.ps1 concatenates two base64 strings, converts them to bytes, and writes them to C:\Users\Public\adobelib.dll
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM; Windows release and validated image are missing. Supply the release and lawful image reference; no version is assumed.

actions.name: execute adobelib.dll using rundll32 with 104 hex character key
actions.description: PowerShell script executes adobelib.dll using rundll32 with a required 104 hex character key
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM; Windows release and validated image are missing. Supply the release and lawful image reference; no version is assumed.

actions.name: adobelib.dll sends POST request to adobe-us-updatefiles.digital
actions.description: adobelib.dll attempts to send a POST request to https://adobe-us-updatefiles.digital/index.php which resolves to specified IP addresses
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM; Windows release and validated image are missing. Supply the release and lawful image reference; no version is assumed.

actions.name: use AnyDesk and Splashtop remote management and monitoring tools

actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM; Windows release and validated image are missing. Supply the release and lawful image reference; no version is assumed.

actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM; Windows release and validated image are missing. Supply the release and lawful image reference; no version is assumed.

actions.name: use remote administration tools including TeamViewer, Plink, PsExec, ScreenConnect, and Zoho Assist
actions.description: LockBit 3.0 affiliates use various remote administration tools such as TeamViewer, Plink, PsExec, ScreenConnect, and Zoho Assist for persistence and lateral movement
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM; Windows release and validated image are missing. Supply the release and lawful image reference; no version is assumed.

actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM; Windows release and validated image are missing. Supply the release and lawful image reference; no version is assumed.

actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM; Windows release and validated image are missing. Supply the release and lawful image reference; no version is assumed.

relations.rationale: The acquisition of a valid NetScaler AAA session cookie depends on exploiting CVE-2023-4966 to obtain system memory information containing the cookie.
Establishing an authenticated session without username, password, or MFA tokens depends on acquiring valid cookies.
Executing adobelib.dll using rundll32 depends on the PowerShell script creating the adobelib.dll file.
The DLL sending a POST request to adobe-us-updatefiles.digital depends on the execution of adobelib.dll.
relations.epistemic_reason: 引句只陳述先後順序，沒有陳述後一步使用前一步的結果；相依屬推論，需人工確認。

relations.rationale: The WinRM session establishment using Python script a.py occurs after dumping LSASS process memory to disk.
